{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "I want you to build a fully static React + Tailwind website for my personal interior design blog / documentation hub. It should feel warm, cozy, editorial, and a little aspirational, like a mix of a home styling journal and a practical design handbook. The vibe should be inspired by Xiaohongshu layout language: lots of soft cards, masonry-style inspiration tiles, rounded corners, warm beige backgrounds, cute labels, image-first browsing, saved-note feeling, but please make it original and polished, not a clone. No backend, no login, no database, no real APIs, no comments system, no user accounts, just static sample content and mock data inside the project is fine.\n\nThe site should be fairly complex and feel like a complete documentation-style website for interior design ideas. I need a homepage with a beautiful hero section introducing the blog, maybe called “Warm Corners” or another tasteful name, with a short tagline about creating calm lived-in spaces. Add featured guide cards such as Small Apartment Styling, Lighting Basics, Color Palettes, Storage Tricks, Vintage Finds, Rental-Friendly Makeovers, and Cozy Bedroom Layers. I also want a sticky top navigation with sections like Home, Style Notes, Room Guides, Materials, Moodboards, Checklist, About, and a search-looking input that is only visual/static, not functional. Make the navigation responsive and elegant on mobile.\n\nPlease create a documentation/blog structure with a left sidebar on desktop for categories and a main reading area. The sidebar can have grouped links like Start Here, Room-by-Room, Design Principles, Materials & Textures, Styling Recipes, Shopping Notes, and Maintenance Tips. The active item should be highlighted with a warm terracotta or caramel accent. On mobile the sidebar can collapse into a horizontal scroll or a simple menu-looking panel, but it does not need real routing if you can make a single-page static layout with anchored sections.\n\nI want several rich content sections, not just a simple landing page. Include a “Design System for a Home” section explaining color, light, proportion, texture, scent, and flow. Include a room guide area with tabs or tab-looking static buttons for Living Room, Bedroom, Kitchen, Bathroom, Entryway, and Workspace. These can show sample cards or sections, they do not need actual dynamic data. Add an article layout section with a long featured article called something like “How to Make a Rental Apartment Feel Collected, Not Temporary” with headings, pull quotes, image placeholders, tip boxes, do/don’t cards, and a small table of contents. Also include a materials library with cards for linen, oak, travertine, rattan, limewash, boucle, brass, ceramic, and wool, each with small notes about where to use them and what they pair with.\n\nThe visual design should use Tailwind carefully: warm ivory background, cream panels, soft peach, clay, muted olive, warm brown text, subtle borders, soft shadows, and lots of whitespace. Typography should feel editorial but readable. If using Google-font-like names, just define font-family fallbacks in CSS, do not load external services. Use placeholder images or gradient blocks if actual images are not available, but make them look intentional like moodboard cards. The whole website should render without external services.\n\nImportant interaction: please add skeleton loading states even though this is static. I want an initial-looking section or components that demonstrate skeleton loading for article cards, moodboard cards, and the guide list. It can be controlled by local React state with a short timeout, or just shown as a dedicated “loading preview” section, but it should look realistic with shimmering warm placeholder blocks. Do not fetch anything from an API. The skeletons should match the final card shapes and use a soft beige shimmer, not harsh gray.\n\nAdd a Xiaohongshu-style inspiration feed section with many static cards in different heights, like little notes: “soft morning kitchen”, “reading nook formula”, “tiny hallway glow-up”, “linen curtain guide”, “coffee table styling”, etc. Each card should have an image area, small title, category pill, short caption, and tiny decorative stats like 128 saves or 42 notes, but all static. Make it masonry-ish using CSS columns or responsive grid, no external masonry library required. Include hover effects like lifting cards, changing border color, and soft image zoom.\n\nAlso add a moodboard builder-looking section but keep it static. It should show swatches, material chips, mini room thumbnails, and a sample palette called Warm Minimal Rental: oat milk, clay, walnut, sage, and brass. Add a checklist area with styled checkboxes for things like measure natural light, choose a base color, repeat wood tones, layer textiles, add vertical storage, style one focal wall. The checkboxes can be visual only or local state only, no persistence.\n\nPlease include an About section for the blog author, written as a personal interior design diary, with a small profile card and values like budget-conscious, renter-friendly, tactile materials, slow decorating, and calm homes. Add a newsletter-looking block at the bottom but make it clearly static/non-functional, with an email input and button only for visual design. Add a footer with categories, credits text, and a gentle note that all content is sample/static.\n\nI want the site to feel production-quality: responsive desktop/tablet/mobile, accessible color contrast, semantic HTML, keyboard-friendly buttons/links where applicable, clean component structure, reusable data arrays for cards/articles/materials, no backend assumptions, no API keys, no authentication. Please use React and Tailwind, and keep everything as a static front-end. Add polished microinteractions: smooth scrolling, hover states, sticky mini table of contents, tag chips, callout boxes, progress-looking reading bar if easy, and animated skeleton shimmer. Make the code organized enough that I can later replace the mock content with my real blog posts manually.",

 },

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
# webdev-structural-gate@1: necessary conditions, not a replacement judge.
_gate_layout = {}
for _line in (shot["output"] or "").splitlines():
    if _line.startswith("LAYOUT:"):
        try:
            _gate_layout = json.loads(_line[len("LAYOUT:"):])
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            pass
        break
if (not isinstance(_gate_layout, dict) or _gate_layout.get("error")
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("text"), str)
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("scroll_w"), (int, float))
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("client_w"), (int, float))
        or _gate_layout["client_w"] <= 0):
    done(None, "Structural measurements unavailable; not scored.")
_gate_text = " ".join(_gate_layout["text"].split())
_gate_kw = cfg.get("gate_keywords") or []
_gate_fails = []
if not _gate_text:
    _gate_fails.append("blank rendered DOM")
if _gate_kw and not any(_kw.casefold() in _gate_text.casefold() for _kw in _gate_kw):
    _gate_fails.append("no brief-keyword DOM presence")
if _gate_layout["scroll_w"] > _gate_layout["client_w"] + 1:
    _gate_fails.append("horizontal overflow")
_gate_report = {"passed": not _gate_fails, "failed": _gate_fails,
                "dom_chars": len(_gate_text), "keywords": _gate_kw,
                "layout": _gate_layout}
(V / "structural_gates.json").write_text(json.dumps(_gate_report, indent=1))
if _gate_fails:
    done(0.0, "Structural gates failed: " + "; ".join(_gate_fails),
         structural_gates=_gate_fails)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Gate trivial, off-brief and overflowing pages to a scored 0 before the vision call, cutting judge spend and the blank-page lottery. Passing pages reach the judge unchanged.
